szoveg_eredeti:
Runway Dev is now on Claude Code, bringing AI video, image and audio to any app you’re building.

With the Runway Dev plugin, Claude Code can build Runway’s API into your app. Describe what your app should generate and it writes the integration the way Runway would.

Get started: https://lnkd.in/eiTY_H7P
